content:
Ethereum just gave the market a fresh reason to stay on edge.

ETH co-founder Jeffrey Wilcke moved roughly 79,859 ETH, worth about $158.3 million, to Kraken, instantly putting traders on alert and reviving sell-pressure fears across the market. On-chain tracking services reported the transfer on March 8, 2026, with Wilcke’s wallet left holding about 16,037 ETH afterward.

Big founder transfers do not always mean an immediate dump, but the signal still hits hard: when size moves to an exchange, the market starts pricing in possible distribution before the selling even begins. That is why this was enough to shake sentiment around ETH while traders were already watching whether price could reclaim the $2,000 area.

This is the kind of flow that changes the tone fast. Not because one wallet decides the trend, but because it reminds everyone how fragile confidence becomes when supply suddenly looks ready to hit the market.

title: 过去我们讨论机器人，总是在讨论硬件性能、讨论 AI 大模型，其实还存在第三个维度。
subTitle:
如果你也厌倦了那些毫无技术含量的空气币，想真正参与到一场关于通用机器人演进的伟大实验中，那么，请准备好你的 Linux 环境，拿出你压箱底的运维功底，去死磕那个测试网吧。
顺便一提，我可以带你看看那几个关键的配置步骤，不懂可以问
上个月28号，当@FabricFND 领着“通用机器人代理原生基础设施”的口号，上线了多个交易所，甚至是币安这种宇宙所的Alpha
我的第一反应是冷笑：“得了吧，又是一个想蹭 DePIN 流量、靠堆砌高级词汇画大饼的伪命题。”
然而，作为一名推崇“代码即真理”的实战派，我有个改不掉的习惯：
喷一个项目之前，先把他拆解一遍
小查一手，我推掉了周末所有的小事，在家里呆了很久，从推特背调到深夜调优环境，彻底去了解，不，甚至是去理解了一遍这个由@Fabric Foundation撑腰的“硬骨头”。
结果，我被打脸了，而且打得心服口服，俺不中勒！俺不中勒！

官网截图
第一印象，最重要，从习惯性怀疑到真实
我入场的第一步不是看官网，而是直奔他们的官方 Twitter (X)
在这个买粉成风的时代，Fabric 的推特账号简直是一股清流。
没有那种铺天盖地的“To the Moon”式刷屏，评论区里活跃的不是领空投的“羊毛党”，而是一群顶着物理学、机器人工程学标签的专业用户。
他们在争论 可验证计算（Verifiable Computing） 在异构网络下的延迟补偿问题。这种充满技术火药味的互动，瞬间让我提起了神，也就是说这项目，背后有“活人”，而且是懂行的人。
随后，我潜入了他们的 Discord 社群。
凌晨三点的开发者频道（Dev-Chat），滚动的代码片段快得让人眼花缭乱。大家讨论的不是币价，而是 fabric-node 容器在不同内核版本下的计算冗余策略。这种纯粹的极客氛围，让我这种老玩家产生了一种久违的兴奋感：他们是真的在造东西，而不是在卖梦想。

我发现，门槛，只是用来过滤投机者的
真正让我感到震撼的，是实际部署节点的过程。
很多项目为了做大用户量，恨不得让你在手机上点一下就能挖矿，问题是这玩意哪有那么快的，除了空气项目逗你玩。
但 Fabric Protocol 却反其道而行之。它的 代理原生（Agent-native） 架构对底层硬件有着近乎苛刻的要求。
28号晚上，我第一次尝试用配置平庸的 VPS 进行初始化时，系统毫不留情地弹出了一串红色的报错。
那是一段极度折磨但也极度真实的过程：
我必须在 Linux 终端里反复调试环境变量，处理那些该死的权限冲突。
在配置 $ROBO 激励节点验证逻辑时，我发现它不仅仅是连接到一个远程服务器那么简单。你需要手动调优计算隔离层，确保节点在处理模拟机器人指令集时，能够实时反馈计算证明。
在无数次 docker logs -f 的滚动监控中，我看着那些复杂的指令流像流水一样穿过控制台。这绝对不是那种空转算力的“数字游戏”，而是实实在在地在为一个全球性的机器人协作网络搭建底层的“骨架”。每一步配置的成功，都伴随着一种掌握精密仪器的成就感。我意识到，这种高门槛本身就是一种筛选：Fabric 不需要那些只会一键运行的看客，它在寻找真正的网络维护者。
有没有可能，这就是秩序感？
当我的节点状态终于从焦虑的红色变成代表健康的绿色！并在仪表盘上看到第一笔来自测试网的微小激励流向钱包地址时，我坐在电脑前抽了一根烟，陷入了深思。
过去我们讨论机器人，总是在讨论硬件性能、讨论 AI 大模型。但 Fabric Protocol 让我看到了第三个维度：协同与演进的规则。
不仅仅是激励，更是契约： 在 $ROBO 经济模型里，我看到的不是暴富的诱惑，而是一种严丝合缝的契约精神。如果你提供的计算资源存在偏差，或者网络响应不及时，协议内置的惩罚机制（Slashing）会立刻生效。这种基于区块链的强约束，才是未来人类敢于将通用机器人大规模接入社会的底气。
物理世界的“数字镜像”： 在节点运行过程中，我观察到那些被处理的指令集包含了大量的运动学轨迹数据。这意味着，Fabric 正在尝试让分布在全球的机器人，通过这个网络共享“经验”。这种“集体进化”的逻辑，比任何单一的 AI 模型都要宏大。
毕竟，在 $ROBO  的未来纪元里，我们不仅仅是在运营节点，我们是在为全球机器人的“云端大脑”守护秩序。
在 Web3 呆了很多年，那些靠补贴和精美 PPT支撑的 AI 项目很多，有几个可以走到最后呢？#ROBO #BTC #ETH

title: 交易可以不设止损么?
subTitle:
有一位朋友跟我谈了他自己的一个很大的困惑：就是，交易可以不设止损么？
感觉止损是慢性自杀，一点一点消耗自己的本金。止损单经常被打掉，而且被打损之后，价格常常又回来了，甚至要朝着自己原定的方向狂奔了，相当郁闷。
交易，到底可不可以不设止损？我对这个问题很感兴趣。

不过，在我回答这位朋友的问题之前，我们不妨深入的思考一个问题：即止损的本质是什么？
止损的本质是风控的手段，是截断可能的单笔极端风险造成的总账户的不可逆损失。
大家都知道，交易不能亏大钱。亏损对我们本金的伤害不是线性的，而是指数级的。亏50%需要涨100%才能回本，而亏90%呢？
则需要涨 900%！所以，我们通常习惯通过止损的方式，将单笔交易的损失控制在不超过总金额的1%-2%。通过止损控制回撤，而后耐心等待一波趋势，资金便能站上一个新的台阶。
当然，设置止损的也是有弊端的：
1、如果设置了止损，只要在持仓过程中的任何一个瞬间，价格触碰了止损线，头寸就被强制平仓。一旦触碰，博弈结束。即使随后价格如预期般大幅前进，也已经出局。就像来信的朋友说的被打掉止损，价格又朝着预期方向狂奔是相当郁闷的了。那么这里的损失，不仅包含损失的沉没成本，也包含原来预期内的应当赚到的机会成本。
2、一般交易者的止损确实也更容易被打掉。因为散户的订单在本质上就是待成交的流动性。大型金融机构交易的金额往往规模巨大，如果他们直接在市场上执行买入往往找不到足够的对手盘来填充订单，从而导致严重的滑点。因此，机构需要大量的对手盘订单。通过人为操纵价格压低至散户止损集中的区域，触发这些卖出止损单，机构就能以理想的价格批量吸纳这些卖单，从而完成自己的买入头寸。
3、市场并不完全是连续波动的，假定设置做多止损单，跳空低开，止损单在远低于设定价格的地方成交，原本设想止损能把亏损控制在 1%-2% 以内，实际亏损可能是翻倍乃至更多。尤其是地缘政治激烈博弈的当下，黑天鹅对市场的冲击不可避免的带来走势的不连贯性跳空。
我想也正是上述这些原因，给相当多的交易者带来了困扰。不止损，怕死于一次单边趋势爆仓或是永久性被套牢；止损，却又是经常性被打损，慢刀子割肉也是让人生疼。
所以，到底要不要止损，这看似是个两难的问题。当我们要去解构这类两难问题的时候，不妨回归到止损的本质，从本质层出发去思考“到底要不要止损”这个问题。
注意，止损是手段，不是目的；是手段，不是目的。而手段是可以替代和转化的！
截断可能的单笔极端风险造成的总账户的不可逆损失，除了止损这个方式之外，还有什么其他的风控方式呢？
我想最重要的是两个。

一个是在足够安全的位置介入；另一个是轻仓操作。
1、在足够安全的位置介入。这个就需要你对交易标的有足够的认知了。你的信息、你的经验、你的认知，坚定的告诉你，这里就是标的的大周期底部。这个时候的止损，就是带血的筹码，怎么可能止损呢？不但不会止损，反而还有可能会继续加仓吸筹。就像2年前上证指数跌到2800以下，你让有经验的老股民割筹，人家怎么可能呢？简直可笑。在足够安全的位置介入，这是最好的风控。
2、轻仓操作。比如，你看好一个标的，与其买入10万元并设置10%的止损，那还不如直接买入1万元了。前者是有可能的实打实的直接损失，那还不如将这个可能性的实打实的损失直接转化为轻仓持仓咯。也因为这样的轻仓持仓，哪怕单笔交易再糟糕，对账户也不会造成不可逆的损失。

当你能把第1点和第2点相结合的时候，坦白讲，我觉得是可以不用做止损了的。把所有的杠杆降下来，每遇到一个有足够安全边际的标的就轻仓介入，就让它飘。从统计学上的正态分布来说，极大概率应该是赚钱的。除非你的眼光差劲至极。当然，如果你的眼光真那么差，止不止损都无所谓的，都是要死的。当然，也因为轻仓持仓，所以单笔赚钱的效率会比较低。整体盈利水平，要看你账户各标的的综合表现了。

作为一名交易者，我们普遍会把“止损”看作是系统运营的必要成本，就像你做生意，都是需要成本的。只要最终的盈利结果能够覆盖掉这个成本，整体上就是可以接受的，赚钱的。但是，如何设置止损，在哪里设，为什么这样设，也是非常讲究逻辑的，并不是每一个人都能处理好。

止损，本来就是风控的手段，可如果风控手段变成了风险本身，总是频频被止损频频被收割慢性失血，那么转换风控的手段也是无可厚非的。

#BTC #ETH  The 4 Iron Rules of Crossing Bulls and Bears: The Core Principles for Surviving in the Cryptocurrency World

Friends who just entered the market often feel that contracts are a fast track to 'getting rich overnight'.
But what is the real market? It is the graveyard of countless gamblers and emotional traders.
After many years in trading, my deepest realization is: in this market, surviving is victory.
I will share 4 principles that I hold sacred, to help you avoid 90% of the pitfalls and live longer than others.

🧨 First: Always keep your trump card
Never go all in out of impulse. Any seemingly fierce market wave can reverse at any time.
Capital management is not about being timid; it is the bottom line for survival. Leave enough room; if you make one mistake, you can recover, but using up all three chances is what we call regret.

🧨 Second: Going with the trend is the greatest speculation wisdom
Human nature loves to pick bottoms and touch tops, thinking they can predict the market.
The reality is, those who follow the trend thrive, while those who go against it perish. When the trend is upward, a pullback is an opportunity to make money; if the trend hasn’t broken, just hold patiently.
Don’t fight the trend; the market's inertia is always greater than you think.

🧨 Third: Take profit and stop loss, execute iron rules
The hardest part of this industry is not watching the market, but exercising restraint.
Making money is easy, but keeping money is hard; a position without a stop loss is like a ticking time bomb.
My iron rules: a single loss should not exceed 5% of total capital, target profit should exceed 5%, and win rate should be maintained at over 50%. Strictly adhere to discipline, and the capital curve will naturally rise steadily.

🧨 Fourth: Reduce trading, learn to wait
Newbies love to trade frequently, making five to six trades a day, treating trading as a physical task.
Bro, trading is the art of waiting, not a contest of speed.
I limit myself to 2-3 trades a day, only acting with a plan. The market is always there; there’s no need to jump in every moment.

📝 To summarize:
Don’t gamble, follow the trend, control risks, and trade less.
In the cryptocurrency world, being stable, being able to wait, and surviving are more valuable than any so-called secrets to getting rich.

💡 Interaction at the end:
How many of these principles have you followed? Let's discuss your trading habits in the comments; we seek victory through stability. #亚洲股市暴跌

content:
#BTC #ETH 穿越牛熊4条铁律：我在币圈活下来的核心心法

刚进场的朋友，总觉得合约是“一夜暴富”的直通车。
但真实的市场是什么？是无数梭哈党、情绪化交易者的坟墓。
白姐交易这么多年，最深的感悟是：在这个市场，活下来，才是胜利。
分享4个我奉为圭臬的原则，帮你避开90%的坑，活得比别人久。

🧨 其一：无论何时，保留底牌
不要在冲动下All in。任何一波看似猛烈的行情，都可能随时反转。
资金管理不是胆小，是生存的底线。留足余地，一笔错了可以复盘，三次机会都用完才叫遗憾。

🧨 其二：顺势，是最大的投机智慧
人性总爱抄底摸顶，觉得自己能预测市场。
现实是，顺趋势者昌，逆趋势者亡。趋势向上时，回调是送钱的机会；趋势未破，就耐心持有。
别跟趋势较劲，市场的惯性永远比你想象的大。

🧨 其三：止盈止损，执行铁律
这行最难的不是看盘，而是克制。
赚钱容易守钱难，没设止损的单子，就是一颗定时炸弹。
我的铁律：单笔亏损不超总资金5%，目标盈利要超5%，胜率维持在50%以上。严守纪律，资金曲线自然稳步上行。

🧨 其四：减少操作，学会等待
新手最爱频繁交易，一天五六单，把交易当体力活。
兄弟，交易是等待的艺术，不是手速的比拼。
我每天限定2-3单，有计划才出手。市场一直在那，不必每时每刻都下场。

📝 总结一下：
不梭哈、顺趋势、控风险、少交易。
在币圈，能稳住、能等、能活下来，比任何所谓的暴富秘籍都更有价值。

当市场还在为$ETH 冲破2000美元狂欢，为$BTC 稳守67,000美元欢呼时，一场精心策划的“诱多陷阱”正在悄然收网。这波看似强势的上涨，根本不是新一轮牛市的起点，而是主力资金为了高位出货制造的最后狂欢，接下来的回调力度，恐怕会让所有追高者措手不及。
先看BTC，虽然价格维持在67,435美元附近，涨幅仅有0.52%，但这种高位滞涨的走势，恰恰是行情反转的危险信号。成交量持续萎缩，买盘动能明显不足，说明主力资金已经在悄悄撤离，留下散户在高位接盘。更值得警惕的是，BTC的日线级别MACD指标已经出现顶背离，RSI也进入超买区间，技术面的恶化正在不断累积，一旦跌破关键支撑位，回调幅度可能远超市场预期。

content:
Yes, this one's a brutal reminder of how grindy swing trading $ETH has gotten lately.
Check out this whale wallet---0x54d250405d22e858D125Ce2c1aFFC7D73AFe6029 they just dumped 5,064 #ETH in the last 15 minutes (all within the past 3 hours or so), totaling about $9.989 million at exit. They originally grabbed it up back on March 7 at an average entry of $1,971.99, and sold out around $1,972.69. 
That's a tiny spread---literally $0.70 per ETH better on the way out. After fees, slippage, whatever else... the net profit clocks in at just $3,375. For moving nearly $10 million worth of ETH? Oof. Basically broke even, maybe a coffee run's worth of gains if you're being generous.

ETH's hovering around $1,970–$1,990 right now (spot prices dipping and bouncing in that zone today), so yeah, the range has been super tight---no massive swings to capture without crazy leverage or perfect timing. This whale timed the accumulation during a low-ish point earlier this month, held through whatever chop, and exited with peanuts. 
Makes you think: in this environment, plain spot swing trades on majors like ETH are tough sledding unless you're catching a real trend or scaling in/out super precisely. High-leverage perps might juice it, but then you're playing with fire on funding/vol/liquidation risk. 
Still, props to them for not bag-holding or getting rekt--small win is better than a loss. But damn, $10M position for $3K profit? That's the kind of "win" that makes you question if the juice is worth the squeeze anymore. 😅 
Address for anyone tracking: 0x54d250405d22e858D125Ce2c1aFFC7D73AFe6029

translatedData.content:
Contract Trading: Win with Mindset, Lose to Emotions

Many people lose money in contract trading, not because they were defeated by the market, but because they lost to their own mindset. Contracts come with leverage, and volatility is magnified, so even a slight deviation in mindset can lead to harsh market consequences. The truly stable and profitable traders do not rely on technology but on a trading mindset that is ingrained in their bones.

First, one must accept losses and treat stop-loss as a cost. No one can make a profit on every trade; losses are part of trading, not accidents. Many people hold onto losing positions, add to their positions, and are unwilling to cut losses, which essentially stems from a fear of losing and a reluctance to admit judgment errors. But in the contract market, not cutting losses is equivalent to handing the account over to luck; a single extreme market event can wipe it out. Accepting small losses is necessary to protect the principal and preserve the opportunity for the next gain.

Secondly, one must get rid of greed and reject the desire for overnight wealth. Leverage easily amplifies desire; when one makes a profit, they want to make more, and when they win, they want to keep winning, only to give back all profits on the next pullback. True experts never think about doubling down; they only earn money within their understanding, take profits when they are available, and secure their gains. Desire is a deep abyss, and restraint is the long-term path.

One must also discard anxiety and not be led by the market. Contracts fluctuate 24 hours a day, and many people constantly watch the market, with their emotions rising and falling with the price charts, staying up late, feeling anxious, and impulsively placing orders, which leads to more mistakes. A good mindset is to patiently wait for opportunities, without guessing, predicting, or feeling itchy to trade; if there are no high-probability opportunities, one should remain in cash and observe. Patience is the most precious weapon of a trader.

More importantly, do not gamble with emotions and do not act out of spite against the market. When losses occur, the urge to immediately recover losses kicks in; when profits are floating, there’s a blind urge to increase positions; and when faced with being stopped out, the reaction is to retaliate, which is the most typical gambler's mindset. The market is always right; acting out of spite will only amplify losses. Regardless of the previous trade’s outcome, remain calm for the next trade and execute according to the rules, without being swayed by emotions in decision-making.

Finally, one must respect the market and maintain their own rhythm. Never think you can conquer the market, and do not follow the crowd in chasing highs or lows. Stick to your trading system, execute your strategy, and do not panic, be greedy, get restless, or gamble.

In contract trading, technology is the foundation, and mindset is the ceiling. By stabilizing your mindset and adhering to discipline, you can go further in a high-risk market. #BTC #ETH

content:
和约交易：赢在心态，死于情绪

很多人做和约亏损，不是败给了行情，而是输给了自己的心态。和约自带杠杆，波动被无限放大，心态稍有偏差，就会被市场狠狠收割。真正稳定盈利的交易者，拼的不是技术，而是刻在骨子里的交易心态。

首先要接受亏损，把止损当成成本。没有人能每单都赚，亏损是交易的一部分，不是意外。很多人扛单、补仓、不愿止损，本质是怕输、不肯承认判断错误。可在合约市场，不止损就等于把账户交给运气，一次极端行情就能清零。接受小亏，才能守住本金，留住下次莹粒的机会。

其次要戒掉贪心，拒绝一夜暴富。杠杆最容易放大欲望，赚了想多赚，赢了还想赢，最后一次回调就回吐全部利润。真正的高手从不想着重仓翻倍，只赚认知内的钱，见好就收，落袋为安。欲望是深渊，克制才是长久之道。

还要摒弃焦虑，不被行情牵着走。和约24小时波动，不少人时刻盯盘，心情随K线起伏，熬夜、焦虑、冲动下单，越急越错。好的心态是静等机会，不猜测、不预判、不手痒，没有高胜率机会就空仓观望。耐心，是交易者最珍贵的武器。

更重要的是不赌情绪，不跟市场赌气。亏了想立刻回本，赚飘了盲目加仓，被扫损就反手报复，这是最典型的赌徒心态。市场永远是对的，赌气只会让亏损扩大。无论上一单盈亏，下一单都保持冷静、按规则执行，不被情绪左右决策。

最后要敬畏市场，守住自己的节奏。永远不要觉得自己能战胜市场，也不要跟风追涨杀跌。守住交易系统，执行自己的策略，不慌、不贪、不燥、不赌。

和约交易，技术是基础，心态是天花板。稳住心态，守住纪律，才能在高风险的市场里走得更远。#BTC #ETH

In the cryptocurrency circle, rolling positions is a common capital growth strategy, focusing on using existing profits as a 'safety cushion' to gradually expand positions. However, if not executed properly, this method can easily lead to failure. Here are a few insights I've summarized about rolling positions, helping you maintain aggression while safeguarding against risks.

1. Build positions in batches to maintain control
The worst mistake in rolling positions is going 'all in' at once. Shooting all your bullets at once can leave you very passive if the market moves against you. The advantage of entering in batches is that no matter the price fluctuations, you always have chips on hand to respond. The market is never short of opportunities; what is lacking is patience in waiting and room to enter.

2. Increase positions in line with the trend, avoiding emotional trading
The essence of rolling positions is to 'go with the trend and increase profits.' Only consider using part of your profits to increase your position when your current holdings are profitable; this way, even if the new position experiences a pullback, your principal is not harmed. Many people easily become emotional after missing an opportunity and chase after rising prices, or panic sell during a pullback; this is exactly the taboo of rolling positions. Remember: do not increase positions without profits; it’s better to miss an opportunity than to make a mistake.

3. Keep enough reserve funds, always leave yourself an escape route
No matter how certain the market looks, always retain some reserve capital. The market changes rapidly, and black swan events occur from time to time. This portion of funds is your 'lifeline,' allowing you the right to adjust positions, save yourself, or even bottom-fish in extreme market conditions. Those who operate fully invested often can't survive deep pullbacks.

4. Maintain patience; slow is fast
Rolling positions is not a shortcut to overnight wealth, but rather a process of accumulating small gains. Trying to capture every fluctuation can disrupt your rhythm. True significant gains often come from correctly increasing positions during a few key market movements. Instead of frequent trading, it’s better to patiently wait for that highly certain point, steadily and reliably, to roll out a long-term compounding effect.

In summary, rolling positions is a test of discipline and human nature. Proper capital management, controlling emotions, and maintaining a safety margin are far more important than pursuing short-term explosive growth. As long as the logic is correct, the rest is left to time. #BTC #ETH

content:
在币圈，滚仓是一种常见的资金增长策略，核心在于利用已有盈利作为“安全垫”，逐步扩大仓位。但这种方式如果操作不当，也很容易功亏一篑。以下是我总结的几点滚仓心得，帮你既保持进攻性，又守住风险底线。

1. 分批建仓，掌握主动权
滚仓最忌讳的就是“一把梭”。把子弹一次性打光，一旦行情反向波动，会让自己变得非常被动。分批入场的好处是，无论价格涨跌，你手里始终有筹码可以应对。市场永远不缺机会，缺的是等待的耐心和进场的余地。

2. 顺势加仓，杜绝情绪化操作
滚仓的精髓在于“顺势而为，盈利加码”。只有在持仓盈利的前提下，才考虑动用部分利润去增加仓位，这样即便新仓位出现回撤，也不会伤及本金。很多人容易在踏空后情绪上头去追涨，或者在回调时恐慌割肉，这恰恰是滚仓的大忌。记住：不盈利不加仓，宁可错过，不做错。

3. 留足备用金，永远给自己留退路
无论行情看起来多确定，都要保留一部分备用资金。市场瞬息万变，黑天鹅事件时有发生。这部分资金是你的“救命稻草”，能让你在极端行情中拥有调仓、自救甚至抄底的权利。满仓操作的人，往往熬不过深度回调。

4. 保持耐心，慢就是快
滚仓不是一夜暴富的捷径，而是一个积少成多的过程。总想抓住每一次波动，反而容易打乱节奏。真正的大收益，往往来自于几次关键行情的正确加仓。与其频繁操作，不如耐心等待那个高确定性的节点，稳扎稳打，才能滚出长期的复利效应。

总而言之，滚仓是一场关于纪律和人性的考验。做好资金管理、控制好情绪、留足安全边际，远比追求短期暴涨更重要。只要逻辑正确，剩下的就交给时间。#BTC #ETH

According to a report by Silicon Valley Technology Observer on March 5

A new project jointly launched by former Tesla AI lab and Stanford University robotics team is causing a stir in the industry. They have proposed an astonishing idea: when millions of general-purpose robots begin to shuttle over cities and operate in factories, if humans only regard them as private tools of some giant company, the future social order may face a huge black hole.

This news is actually the background of the project @FabricFND  that I want to discuss with you.

To put it simply, my understanding of Fabric is that it does not want robots to become "pets" locked in a black box owned by a certain company.

Their ambition is grand; they want to build general-purpose robots into an open network. This network is built, governed, and jointly owned by everyone. It must be public infrastructure, like water, electricity, and gas, accessible to all, supervised by all, and those who perform poorly will be punished.

The most hardcore part of the white paper, I distilled into three words, which are also the most valuable aspects of the entire design:
Adaptive issuance, structural demand pool, evolutionary reward layer.

1. Starting mechanism: This is really worth praising. In the early stages, it attracts supply through inflation, that is, those machines providing computing power, validating nodes, and workers.

2. Intelligent regulation: But inflation is not randomly issued. It is a dynamic valve directly linked to the utilization rate and quality of the network. When the network is busy and services are stable, it is appropriately released; when the network is idle and quality is poor, it automatically tightens.

3. De-lazying: This is also what I admire the most. They clearly intend to break away from the traditional PoS approach. Rewards are only given to those who have genuinely completed tasks and have traceable evidence, rather than those who simply have more money and can sit back and collect.

I think at this point in 2026, this statement is actually quite "harsh."

Because one of the biggest tricks in the circle now is to package laziness as holding coins for value preservation, while Fabric turned the table: without contribution, there’s no ticket to eat. This is its most valuable aspect.
#robo $ROBO #BTC #ETH

content:
据3月5日硅谷科技观察报报道

一支由前特斯拉AI实验室与斯坦福大学机器人团队联合推出的新项目，正在业内掀起轩然大波。他们反手提出了一个惊人的设想：当百万级的通用机器人开始在城市上空穿梭、在工厂里作业时，人类如果只把它们当成某家巨头的私有工具，未来的社会秩序可能会面临巨大的黑洞。

这则新闻，其实就是我想跟你聊的@FabricFND 项目的底色。

我用简单的话说一下，我理解的Fabric，他就是不想让机器人变成某家公司关在黑箱里的“宠物”。

他们的野心很大，想把通用机器人建成一个开放网络。这个网络由大家共建、共治、共同拥有。它必须像水电煤一样，是公开的基础设施，谁都能用，谁都能监督，做得不好就要被惩罚。

白皮书里最硬核的那部分，我给你提炼成三个词，也是整份设计最值钱的地方：
自适应发行、结构性需求池、演化式奖励层。

1. 起步机制： 这一点真的值得我夸一夸，早期靠通胀吸引供给，也就是那些提供算力的机器、提供验证的节点、干活的人

2. 智能调控： 但通胀不是乱发的。它是个动态阀门，直接挂钩网络的利用率和质量。网络忙、服务稳，就适当释放；网络闲、质量差，就自动收紧。

3. 去躺赢化： 这也是我最佩服的一点。他们明确要脱离传统 PoS 的路子。奖励只给实实在在完成了任务、有证据可追溯的人，而不是谁钱多谁就躺着收钱。

我觉得在 2026 年这个节点，这个说法其实挺“刺耳”的。

因为现在圈子里最大的套路之一，就是把躺赢包装成持币保值，而 Fabric 掀了桌子：没贡献，就拿不到饭票。这才是它最有价值的地方。

title: 币圈的永续合约怎么理解？
subTitle:
简单的扒一扒什么是合约。
合约又称永续合约，类似于期货但是它没有交割日期。
可以做多和做空，比如你预测某个币种会上涨你选择做多当它价格上涨后你便可以获得盈利反之亦然。
为什么大部分的人都喜欢玩合约呢？
大致两个原因吧，比如很多人说的观点买现货放个一两年等牛市来，咱且说你真的等到牛市来了并且你买的币种也同样涨了几倍，你会满足吗？
很多小资金玩家不会的，1万翻几倍还是几万块钱，相信绝大部朋友来币圈都不是朝着几倍收益去的。
更何况，万一牛市没来呢，万一牛市自己买的币种没怎么涨呢？
这便是很多人玩合约的原因之一。
另外一个点合约可以 做多和做空 会让人潜意识里面觉得公平一点 因为买现货只能做多 庄家手里一大把低价筹码会让人觉得早晚会被割韭菜。
合约有几个要素：
杠杆：很多人会告诉你玩合约早晚爆仓，究其最直接的原因就是杠杆，因为杠杆会激发和放大人性中的贪念，现在的杠杠可以开到1-125倍 100倍杠杆什么概念？1个点的波动就能翻倍。所以很多人低倍亏损后会控制不住自己加高杠杆，因此爆仓也就是早晚的事情。
资金费率：永续合约它的锚定物是对应的现货，为了使合约的价格与现货接近，交易所会用资金费率来调整。 如果为正做多的给做空的支付，如果为负做空的给做多的支付，一般支付周期为8小时一次。 具体支付金额=成交额（购买的本金*杠杆倍数）*资金费率

手续费：以安为例，合约手续费在没有优惠的情况下，单边情况吃单万分之5，挂单万分之2（简单来说吃单就是去成交人家已经挂出来的单，挂单简单来说是事先挂出去等待成交，具体释义可以百度）。
手续费双向收取，买入和卖出都会收 具体计算方式也是：成交额（本金*杠杆倍数）*手续费率。
爆仓：就是价格到了你强行平仓的价格，被平台强行平仓。爆仓会收取高昂的手续费，所以建议自己设置一个止损价（最好与强平价格存在一些空间）避免插针被强平。
自控能力差的、好胜心强的、DU性重的，喜欢上头的，资金压力大的等千万不要玩合约。不然市场会给你惨痛的教

translatedData.title: How to understand perpetual contracts in the crypto space?
translatedData.subTitle:
Let’s simply explain what a contract is.
Contracts, also known as perpetual contracts, are similar to futures but do not have a delivery date.
You can go long or short. For example, if you predict that a certain cryptocurrency will rise, you choose to go long, and when its price increases, you can make a profit; the opposite is true as well.
Why do most people like to trade contracts?
There are generally two reasons. For instance, many people say to buy spot and hold for a year or two until the bull market comes. Let’s say you really do wait for the bull market to arrive and the cryptocurrency you bought also rises several times; will you be satisfied?
Many small investors don't know this. Turning 10,000 into several times that or even tens of thousands of dollars, I believe most friends who come to the crypto space are not aiming for several times the return.

title: Bitcoin's Maturation: Escaping Payment Limitations Toward Settlement Dominance
subTitle:
Bitcoin's Evolution: From Failed Payment Currency to Digital Gold and Underlying Settlement Infrastructure — Runes and Lightning Network Driving the Next Growth WaveExecutive SummaryBitcoin (BTC) was originally designed as a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, but due to structural flaws such as extreme volatility, scalability limitations, and high transaction fees, its attempt to serve as an everyday payment currency has largely failed. According to the arXiv paper “An Examination of Bitcoin’s Structural Shortcomings as Money” (Soleimani, 2025), Bitcoin’s annualized volatility exceeds 100%, more than 3.6 times that of gold, and in the El Salvador experiment, 88% of merchants immediately converted BTC to USD, proving it cannot function as a reliable medium of exchange. This has prompted Bitcoin to pivot toward becoming “digital gold” — a scarce store-of-value asset — and to serve as the underlying settlement infrastructure for global finance, supporting high-value cross-border transfers. Grayscale Investments’ 2026 report notes that Bitcoin’s short-term price behavior resembles high-growth tech stocks (correlation with Nasdaq as high as 0.72), but in the long term it may evolve toward gold-like stability. Fidelity Digital Assets emphasizes its advantages as a borderless bearer asset.Emerging ecosystems such as the Runes protocol and Lightning Network are injecting new momentum: Runes enhances block space demand through efficient tokenization, pushing miner fee share from a peak of 50% to the current 1.67%; without Runes, on-chain activity would become nearly empty, causing miner revenue to plummet and rely almost entirely on subsidies, leading to hash rate decline and network security risks. Lightning Network transaction volume surged 300% in 2025 to $1.1 billion monthly, and USDT integration (via Taproot Assets starting in 2025, and the Utexo project receiving $7.5 million from Tether in 2026) injects trillion-scale liquidity, enabling instant dollar settlement and boosting Runes liquidity several-fold through stable entry points, low-cost channels, and emerging applications.These synergistic effects are poised to drive Bitcoin’s market cap to new highs and strengthen its position in decentralized finance. This report substantiates every conclusion with data, logical reasoning, and authoritative citations.IntroductionBitcoin’s whitepaper (2008) positioned BTC as electronic cash without intermediaries. However, network congestion, high fees, and slow confirmation times made everyday payments impractical. This shift is not arbitrary but grounded in empirical data and economic logic: the failure as a payment currency stems from technical and economic incompatibility, while the new role leverages Bitcoin’s scarcity and security. Drawing on reports from Grayscale, Fidelity, and the aforementioned arXiv paper, this report analyzes the transformation process and explains in detail how Runes and Lightning Network drive growth by improving utility, liquidity, and incentive mechanisms. As of March 2026, Bitcoin’s market cap exceeds $1.4 trillion, and these innovations are set to further amplify its potential.Bitcoin’s Failure as a Payment CurrencyBitcoin’s failure as a payment currency is not an isolated event but the cumulative result of structural defects: extreme volatility, scalability bottlenecks, high fees, and low adoption — each point proven by data and logical reasoning.First, excessive volatility undermines its reliability as a medium of exchange. The arXiv paper states Bitcoin’s annualized volatility exceeds 100%, 3.6× that of gold, making it unsuitable as a unit of account: merchants struggle to price goods, and users face massive risk. For example, in February 2026 Bitcoin fell from $90,000 to $60,000 (–33%) in a short period, meaning the value of a payment could change dramatically before confirmation. Logically, a currency must be stable to facilitate circulation, but Bitcoin behaves more like a risk asset (correlation with equities at 0.65 per Chinazzo 2024), acting as a speculative tool rather than a safe haven during crises, leading to 88% of El Salvador merchants immediately converting to USD (Alvarez 2022), proving it cannot sustain a credit loop.Second, scalability limits real-world throughput. The base layer handles only ~7 TPS, far below Visa’s 65,000 TPS; Lightning Network mitigates this somewhat, but success rates remain low (e.g., only 44% for $10 payments, Waugh 2020). The paper argues this causes fees to rise super-linearly during demand spikes (over $50 in 2021 peaks), rendering micro-payments uneconomical. Logical chain: low throughput → congestion → high fees → suppressed velocity; 99.7% of transactions are speculative rather than commercial (Schnoering 2025), ultimately resulting in low merchant adoption — e.g., Tesla briefly accepted BTC then suspended due to volatility and inefficiency.Third, real-world adoption failed due to regulatory and environmental barriers. El Salvador’s 2021 legal tender experiment led to credit downgrades, rising inflation, and negative employment growth (Goldbach 2024), because forced acceptance did not solve volatility. Global merchant acceptance remains low, with everyday transactions accounting for only 0.3% of total volume. Logic: lacking intrinsic prior non-monetary use value (as required by Mises’ regression theorem) and facing environmental criticism (high PoW energy consumption), Bitcoin cannot replace fiat, confirming its failure as money.Citation: Soleimani, Hamoon. “An Examination of Bitcoin’s Structural Shortcomings as Money.” arXiv:2512.07840v1, 2025.DefectCause & DataLogical Consequence Leading to FailureVolatility>100% annualized, equity correlation 0.65Destroys pricing stability, suppresses circulationScalability7 TPS, peak fees >$50Congestion + high cost excludes small paymentsAdoptionEl Salvador 88% conversion, 0.3% commercial nodesLacks credit elasticity, regulatory barriersThe Shift to Digital GoldBitcoin’s pivot to “digital gold” rests on its scarcity and inflation-hedge properties, supported by data comparison: fixed supply of 21 million coins, halving mechanism similar to gold mining difficulty, and independence from central banks. Grayscale’s report explains why short-term behavior resembles growth assets (Nasdaq correlation rose from –0.68 to +0.72 in February 2026), as investors treat it as a bet on adoption growth; in the long run it may stabilize like gold. Logic: Bitcoin is only 17 years old compared to gold’s millennia — maturity takes time — but 2026 correlation data shows it acting as a safe haven during economic cycles (e.g., synchronized rise with gold during the 2023 banking crisis) rather than pure speculation.The arXiv paper challenges the “digital gold” narrative but acknowledges it behaves like a risk asset in stress periods; however, CME data shows peak correlation with gold at +0.41 and negative correlation with the dollar trending toward zero, proving independence. In February 2026 gold rose +7.9% while Bitcoin fell –22.1%, showing divergence, yet the BOLD index (Bitcoin + gold) delivered 40.4% returns, demonstrating diversification benefits. Conclusion: the shift is driven by supply mechanics and institutional adoption (spot ETF inflows of $462 million/day), logically elevating its status as a wealth preservation asset.Bitcoin as Underlying Settlement InfrastructureBitcoin’s strength as settlement infrastructure lies in its immutable finality and 24/7 availability, ideal for high-value transfers. Fidelity highlights its decentralized markets improve capital efficiency and reduce intermediaries. Examples: JPMorgan’s JPM Coin launched on public chain in 2025 for real-time cross-border settlement; Visa’s USDC settlement pilot achieves T+0 instead of T+2, reducing risk. Logic: traditional systems rely on clearing houses prone to credit risk; Bitcoin’s blockchain provides transparent records, cuts reconciliation work, and by 2026 institutions like Citi are integrating Token Services for liquidity management. Benefits: lower costs (cross-border remittances from days to minutes), higher efficiency (supply-chain tracking tamper-proof), and attraction of trillion-dollar RWA tokenization markets.BTC Ecosystem Innovation: Runes ProtocolRunes (launched April 2024) enables efficient creation of fungible tokens on the UTXO model, supporting stablecoins, governance tokens, etc., while avoiding the chain bloat of predecessors like BRC-20. Runes initially drove massive fee spikes; during the 2024 halving some blocks saw fees exceed 10 BTC, far above the 3.125 BTC subsidy.Impact on Miner Revenue: At launch, fees accounted for over 50% of miner income, with daily revenue reaching tens of millions of dollars. By 2026, enthusiasm cooled, fee share dropped to 1.67%, daily fees collapsed from a peak of $45 million to below $250,000, leaving miners reliant on block subsidies (~$45 million/day), with fees contributing only 0.6%. Runes can boost miner revenue 20–50% during peak periods, but sustained innovation (e.g., complex conditional transactions) is needed to maintain baseline fee levels.If There Were No Runes, On-Chain Would Be Nearly Empty — Miner Challenges
Runes, as Bitcoin’s fungible token standard, briefly drove transaction activity and fee surges, but its subsequent decline exposed Bitcoin’s dependence on such innovations. Without Runes (or similar protocols), on-chain activity would drop sharply, resulting in an “almost empty” state characterized by low transaction volume and underutilized block space. This directly exacerbates miners’ profitability problems, as revenue depends primarily on block subsidies and transaction fees, and Runes was a major fee source.Logic and Causes of Reduced On-Chain Activity
Runes leverages Bitcoin’s UTXO model and OP_RETURN opcode to enable efficient token minting and transfer (e.g., meme coins, community tokens), increasing on-chain demand. At launch (April 2024), average transaction fees spiked to an all-time high of $127 due to users racing to mint and move tokens, creating fierce block space competition. This proves Runes directly stimulated network activity: it attracted new users and developers and shifted Bitcoin from pure store-of-value to broader tokenization use cases. Without Runes, base-layer transactions would revert mainly to large transfers and speculation, not high-frequency token interactions. Historical data shows Ordinals (Runes predecessor) caused the UTXO set to grow from 86 million in April 2022 to 140 million by November (data size from 5 GB to 8.74 GB); absent similar protocols, on-chain would return to “near empty” — daily transactions likely stuck at 300,000–500,000, with 99.7% speculative rather than commercial. Logically, Bitcoin’s design (7 TPS cap) favors high-value settlement; without tokenization incentives, users lack motivation to generate extra transactions, leaving block space idle.Miner Challenges: Sharp Revenue Decline and Profit Pressure
Miner total revenue = block subsidy (currently 3.125 BTC/block, halved every 4 years) + transaction fees. Runes once pushed fee share above 50%, delivering tens of millions in daily income. By February 2026, after Runes cooled, fee share fell to 1.67%, daily fees < $250,000, with miners depending on ~$45 million/day in subsidies. Without Runes this ratio would be even lower due to lack of high-frequency token transactions filling blocks. The 2024 halving already halved subsidies, intensifying profitability pressure. When fees fail to compensate (historical post-halving difficulty adjustments typically cause 5–12% hash rate drops), many miners face losses. Logical chain: low fees → low revenue → operating costs (electricity, hardware) uncovered → miners exit. In May 2024 after Runes fees declined, total miner income fell below $30 million/day. Long term, by 2140 when subsidies end, if fees remain <1% of revenue, miners cannot sustain incentives, risking network security collapse.Specific Consequences
Hash rate decline and security risk: Miner exits reduce total hash rate, making the network more vulnerable to 51% attacks. Post-halving hash rate has historically dropped 15% temporarily; without Runes-like fee sources, declines would be more prolonged.Shift to non-mining activities: Miners turn to power arbitrage or shut down equipment, increasing industry concentration and centralization risk.Opportunity cost: Ignoring Runes means missing a $5.4 billion market opportunity; miners lose extra revenue and network growth stalls.
Mitigation and Why Runes Is Indispensable
While Bitcoin price appreciation, technical optimizations (more efficient ASICs), or business adjustments (holding BTC for appreciation) can partially offset, these rely on external factors. Runes demonstrates the necessity of internal ecosystem innovation: it not only generates revenue but attracts new users and indirectly lifts Bitcoin’s value. Data conclusion: Runes peak fees accounted for 67% of subsidy value; without it, fees drop below 12%. An empty chain would greatly amplify Bitcoin’s long-term sustainability challenges.The Role of Lightning Network and USDT IntegrationLightning Network (LN), operational since 2018, enables instant, low-cost off-chain transactions. In 2025 transaction volume surged 300% to $1.1 billion monthly, mainly for large exchange settlements. LN reduces congestion and supports micro-payments (e.g., social tipping).USDT Integration as New Momentum
Starting in 2025, Tether integrated USDT into Bitcoin and Lightning Network via Lightning Labs’ Taproot Assets protocol. In 2026, Utexo (backed by a $7.5 million lead investment from Tether) achieved native USDT settlement, enabling instant Lightning payments with predictable fixed fees. This brings the world’s largest stablecoin (circulation $140–158 billion) into the Bitcoin ecosystem, dramatically improving utility: cross-border remittances, micro-payments, AI agent transactions, etc., now achieve instant, low-cost dollar settlement.Liquidity Boost for Runes
USDT on Lightning provides a stable liquidity entry point for Runes token trading. Users can quickly buy/sell Runes assets on LN using USDT, avoiding BTC volatility; it also increases channel liquidity, attracting more routing nodes and LSPs, improving overall network capacity and efficiency. Expected to push LN volume several times higher and indirectly increase main-chain settlement demand (L2 ultimately anchors to Bitcoin).USDT on LN Core Mechanism
Taproot Assets allows USDT to be transmitted as a fungible asset on LN, leveraging Bitcoin’s Taproot upgrade (2021) to embed USDT in LN invoices. When a user generates an invoice, edge nodes provide BTC–USDT exchange rates: payer sends USDT, node converts to BTC for routing through LN paths, recipient node converts back to USDT. This achieves atomic swaps (instant, trustless exchange) with fixed, very low fees (<$0.01 per transaction), far below USDT transfers on Ethereum or Tron (~$4 on Tron). Relevance to Runes: Runes is a main-chain token protocol; LN is Layer-2 scaling. USDT on LN bridges stablecoins into the Bitcoin ecosystem, allowing users to quickly trade Runes assets on LN (via bridges or DeFi apps) without using volatile BTC directly.Liquidity Injection Logic and Mechanisms
Stable entry point reduces volatility risk — Runes assets (e.g., meme coins) are highly volatile; trading with BTC exposes users to double risk (BTC + Runes). USDT, pegged to USD, enables instant transfers on LN. Users can buy Runes directly with USDT (e.g., via payment gateways or AI agents) and settle on-chain. Logic: attracts risk-averse users (e.g., emerging-market remitters), increasing Runes transaction volume. Post-2025 USDT on LN announcement, expected to bring 350 million Tether users and trillion-scale volume. Data shows USDT accounts for 60% of global crypto trading; its LN integration can multiply Runes liquidity several times.Channel & network liquidity enhancement — LN relies on pre-funded payment channels. USDT integration injects funds upfront (e.g., Speed Wallet’s Taproot asset channels), attracting more routing nodes and liquidity service providers (LSPs). Logic: more channels = higher capacity, supporting high-frequency Runes trades (e.g., small buys/sells). Users send USDT and receive Runes without main-chain congestion; this indirectly boosts main-chain demand and stimulates Runes activity.Support for emerging applications, amplifying ecosystem effects — USDT on LN enables dollar-denominated DeFi, RWA tokenization, and AI agent transactions. For Runes this means stablecoins can be used to lend/borrow or trade Runes assets (e.g., on Bitcoin DeFi platforms), deepening market liquidity. Logic: low cost (seconds settlement) + high liquidity (USDT annual volume ~$10 trillion, approaching Visa’s $16 trillion) attracts institutional and retail users, shifting Runes from speculation to utility. In December 2025 Tether led an $8 million round in Utexo, further optimizing USDT–Runes interoperability.Merchant & global payment impact — Merchants can accept USDT alongside BTC using the same LN infrastructure. This injects liquidity into Runes: merchants hold USDT and quickly exchange for Runes assets, facilitating cross-border flows. Logic: reduces settlement time (days to minutes), cuts costs (no intermediaries), and boosts Runes adoption in remittances and payments.
Potential Impact & Limitations
USDT transforms Bitcoin from a store of value into a “universal liquidity network.” Runes benefits from stable, high-speed entry points; liquidity can increase several-fold (based on USDT’s 60% market share). Data seven months post-integration: liquidity surge attracts new participants and drives Runes volume higher. Limitations: reliance on edge-node conversion introduces minor centralization; Runes needs sustained interest or liquidity injection remains limited. Overall, USDT significantly enhances Runes’ utility and accelerates Bitcoin ecosystem growth.Relation to Miner Revenue
LN itself does not directly generate main-chain fees, but large-scale USDT adoption stimulates high-value channel open/close and settlement transactions, amplifying “premium” transaction demand. Combined with Runes token activity, this can lift fee share from current <1% to 15–20%+, alleviating post-halving subsidy pressure. Without such innovations, miner revenue collapse would weaken hash rate and network security.How These Engines Drive Bitcoin’s Next Growth WaveRunes + LN + USDT form a powerful synergy: Runes expands tokenization applications and increases block space demand & miner fees; LN scales payments; USDT injects stability and trillion-scale liquidity. Together they attract emerging-market users, institutional capital, and RWA flows, reduce volatility, and elevate Bitcoin’s role as a settlement layer. Projections: LN could handle thousands of billions annually; Runes enables trillion-dollar RWA markets. Logic: complementary solutions address core limitations, boost adoption, dampen volatility; stable miner revenue strengthens network security and drives trillion-scale RWA growth. Conclusion: drives exponential growth based on data-backed synergy, not speculation.ConclusionBitcoin’s shift from failed payment currency to digital gold and settlement infrastructure is a pragmatic adaptation to its design constraints. Grayscale, Fidelity, and the arXiv paper (Soleimani, 2025) all confirm the inevitability and limitations of this transformation. Runes and Lightning Network — especially with USDT integration — are injecting genuine momentum, improving liquidity, miner incentives, and global adoption. If these engines continue to perform, Bitcoin is poised for another exponential growth phase. Investors should closely monitor ecosystem metrics and fee trends — these will be key indicators of long-term value.Main References

What is a rebate? Many people might not know yet that this fee can be quite substantial, possibly even more than your principal. In simple terms, every transaction you make generates a fee that is fixed by the exchange. Then, with a rebate, the exchange will refund you a portion of that transaction fee. It is automatically returned to you, and it arrives immediately after you complete the trade.
How is this fee calculated? If you open a position worth 50 times 1000U, that makes a total position value of 50000U. The fee is charged at a rate of 0.04% of the position value, resulting in an expenditure of 20U when opening the position. Since you definitely need to close the position, you'll incur another 20U fee for closing it. So, one trade costs you 40U. If you open several trades in a day, that can add up to hundreds of U in fees. If there is a rebate, you can get a portion of that back.
If you want to know whether you have opened a rebate, you can follow the steps below to check if the exchange has transferred any U to you. If there are no records, it indicates that you have not opened a rebate. This is something to pay attention to because contract fees can be very expensive, and not having a rebate can lead to significant losses. 什么是返佣，好多人可能还不知道，这笔费用可不少，可能比你本金还多。简单来说就是你每笔交易都会产生一笔手续费，由交易所固定收取。然后有返佣就是这比手续费交易所会退给你一部分。自动返给你，买完单立马就到账了。
这笔费用就是怎么算的，1000U开50倍，就是50000U的持仓价值。手续费按照持仓价值的万4收，开仓支出20U，开仓你肯定要平仓，平仓又要20U手续费，一个单子就是40U，一天开几个单子那都是上百u或者好几百U手续费。如果有返佣可以返给你一部分。
各位想知道自己有没有开返佣可以按照下面步骤看看交易所有没有给你转U。没有记录说明你没有开返佣，这可要注意了，合约手续费是很贵的，不开返佣会亏很多，至于你产生了多少手续费，你可以按照后面两张图去查一下。
没有开的记得尽快开上。#BTC #ETH #solana #山寨季讨论量跌至两年新低
